items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I rehearsed with Cab Calloway's band that followed us... and I rehearsed with Cab Calloway all the music for his show.

ctx.x: I know ... somebody said in a rehearsal, "Oh, I played that wrong", and Duke said, "Don't change it -- the mistakes are the best part!"

At the Cotton Club, when we left the Cotton Club, I rehearsed with Cab Calloway's band that followed us, you know, we left to go on one nighters then; to go all over the country, and I rehearsed with Cab Calloway all the music for his show. We went on the road and we were breaking records all over the place, you know? Because Duke Ellington's orchestra got so big! Oh, we did tremendous business.
